resources.string: Include this device\'s network-quality data in a drive-test coverage session?
Serving cell first, then neighbours. Refreshes every 5 seconds.
No cells reported right now. Keep location on, and it will refresh on its own.
Shown on this phone only. Nothing here is uploaded.
Grant location permission to see Wi-Fi networks.
Android limits how often Wi-Fi can scan. Results refresh automatically.
No saved drives on this phone yet.
Removes the route from this phone. Anything already uploaded stays on the server.
This saved drive has no fixes.
No route yet. Start a drive test to draw one.
Grant location to see live readings.

This app needs three permissions to work.

• Location and phone: to read your live signal and nearby Wi-Fi. Android reports neither without them.
• Notifications: so a request from NTC can reach you.

When you allow them, the app sends anonymous signal readings to NTC for about one minute, then stops by itself. After that, sharing stays off until you turn it on in Settings.
Location permission is off for this app. Signal, Cells, and Wi-Fi need it.
Phone location is off. Turn it on to see cell and Wi-Fi readings.
GPS is off, so this phone may not report cells. Set Location to High accuracy.
Location is needed to show live readings. You can allow it later from Settings.
Tick this to add the Cells and Map tabs. Without it the app shows Signal, Wi-Fi and Settings. Your choice is kept on this phone for now. It will come from the NTC app login once that is connected.
Enter this phone\'s mobile number so NTC can send it a request when needed. Nothing is shared until you accept a request. You can also do this later in Settings.
This phone is already registered as %1$s. Nothing more is needed after the update.
Open the app to review. Nothing is sent until you accept.
Battery: unrestricted. Requests can reach this phone while it is locked or idle.
Battery is restricted. Requests may not reach this phone while it is locked or idle.
Trace requests from NTC appear here. Nothing is sent until you tap Accept.
%1$s Will keep trying in the background.
This phone is registered as %1$s (number verified).
This phone is registered as %1$s. The number is not verified yet: tap here to verify it.
We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to %1$s. Type it here to prove this phone has that number.
Type the 6-digit code from the SMS.
The code could not be sent: %1$s
Could not reach the server. Try again shortly.
An NTC operator recorded your agreement by phone. Tap Accept to continue.
A reading every 15 seconds and a speed test every 30 minutes on mobile data, until you tap Stop.
Accepted. Sharing location for this request is not in this build yet.

Measures ping, packet loss, download and upload. The mobile data test uses NTC\'s mobile network even while you are on Wi-Fi, and about 8 MB of data. The Wi-Fi test uses your Wi-Fi. Runs only when you tap a button.
Testing. Keep the app open for about 20 seconds.

%7$s
Ping %1$s ms · jitter %2$s ms · loss %3$s%%
Download %4$s Mbps · Upload %5$s Mbps
Radio at test: %6$s
Measuring your signal and speed. This takes about 30 seconds.
Not sent: the phone\'s position is needed. Switch on location and try again.
Register this phone first, then report the problem.
Share my location with NTC until this is fixed
Sends your signal and location every 5 minutes so NTC can find the cause. It stops when NTC closes the complaint, after 3 days, or when you tap Stop on the notification.
Sharing your location with NTC until this is fixed. Tap Stop on the notification to end it.
Sharing could not be started. Your report was still sent.

If you agree, this phone sends four short readings a day, around 10 am, 2 pm, 7 pm and midnight: the network, the signal level and the cell it is using. No phone number is sent, and the readings are not linked to you or your number. If you also allow it, a rough area of about 500 m is added, never your exact location. NTC uses them to see where and when the signal is weak. You can turn this off in Settings at any time.
Four readings a day (network, signal, cell) with no number. A rough area of about 500 m only if location is allowed all the time.

The readings are taken while the app is closed, so Android shows a location only if you choose \"Allow all the time\". Then each reading adds the centre of the 500 m square you are in, never your exact location. Without it the readings are still sent, placed by the cell instead.
Add a rough area (location all the time)
Records a location fix every 2 seconds while it runs. A notification stays on screen, and its Stop button ends the test.
Reading the cell and location now…
No reading. Location permission may not be granted, or no cell information is available.
Registering shares this device\'s last known location with verified rescue operators only, searchable by this phone number during a disaster. You can withdraw at any time.

Rescue sharing uses this phone\'s registered number, %1$s. Turning it on shares this phone\'s last known location with verified rescue operators only, and only while an emergency is declared. You can turn it off at any time.

Photo sent. It appears on the site page after an admin approves it.

Back to automatic: the app works it out from movement and GPS.

Share: the signal readings and route of this drive are sent to Nepal Telecom when you stop, and sharing is switched off again afterwards. Keep on phone: the drive is saved on this phone only and nothing is sent.
